content.what_it_is: MATLAB function that scans the first mfreq frequency components, counts adjacent repeated frequencies, sums Spectrum_Energy*pi over each adjacent run, maps condensed values back at selected original indices, derives an Hmo diagnostic, plots the sparse 1-D spectrum versus the no-coherence frequency axis, then plots a 31-point moving-average version and saves two PNG files (L1-L77).
entities: function Plot_1Df and inputs freq, freq_no_coh, Spectrum_Energy, freq_resolution, mfreq, Coherent_Percentage declared at L1
run counter k initialized at L4 and L14 and incremented at L9/L19
loop index i defined at L5 and L15
adjacent-run counts reps_condensed assigned at L7/L10
condensed spectral values Syy1d_f assigned at L17/L20
condensed frequencies freq_condensed and representative indices freq_index assigned at L21-L22
height diagnostic Hmo_Syy1d_f defined and rounded at L26-L27
full-axis sparse spectrum Syy1d_f_whole defined at L29-L30
moving-average spectrum Syy1d_f_whole_ma defined at L57

equations.ref: accumulate energy for an adjacent duplicate
start energy for a new adjacent frequency run
place condensed values on reference-sized sparse vector

calls: set and gca at L34, L50, L59, and L75
grid on/minor at L44-L45 and L69-L70
saveas, gcf, fullfile, and num2str at L52 and L77
unresolved: Condensation algorithm defect across L5-L24: duplicates are merged only when equal frequencies are adjacent. The gate-read Coherence_Spectrum replaces guest values in place without sorting, so equal host frequencies can be separated; those nonadjacent coherent components remain separate and their energies are not combined.
Exact floating-point equality at L6/L16 is the only grouping criterion, with no tolerance; numerically equivalent frequencies produced through different arithmetic can fail to condense.

mfreq is trusted as the loop bound at L5/L15 rather than derived/checked against freq and Spectrum_Energy. freq_index is then used against a vector sized from freq_no_coh at L29-L30, so inconsistent lengths cause out-of-range access.
reps_condensed at L4-L12 and freq_condensed at L21 are computed but never used in plotting or output; the displayed placement relies only on representative original indices.

The 31-point moving average at L57 is applied after zeros are inserted at all non-representative positions at L29-L30. This spreads energy across zero gaps and changes amplitudes based on sparse index layout rather than smoothing the condensed frequency/value pairs.
Hmo_Syy1d_f is computed and rounded at L26-L27 but never checked or displayed because its title lines are commented.
The first figure is closed at L54, but the second figure opened at L56 is left open after the final save at L77.
